jobs.description:
“I can be myself at work.”

You are more than a job title. We want you to feel comfortable doing great work and bringing your best, authentic self to everything you do. We value your talents, traditions, and uniqueness—and we’re committed to fostering a strong sense of belonging in a respectful workplace.

“I can lead a full life.”

Our Advisor Practice Management team delivers industry-leading learning programs, consulting, and coaching to top advisory teams and partner firms. We strive to be the business partner of choice by helping advisors grow, scale, and strengthen their practices. Leveraging Capital Group's distribution reach and relationships, we bring the proven skills, behaviors, and strategies that drive growth for elite advisory teams.

Guided by our proprietary Pathways to Growth research, we provide tailored learning experiences that help advisors develop and implement critical business-building capabilities at every stage of their careers. Our approach emphasizes practical application, measurable outcomes, and ongoing accountability. Through these engagements, we deepen advisor relationships, create business impact, and strengthen opportunities for partnership with Capital Group.

Advisor Practice Management Consultants (APMCs) engage advisors through keynote presentations, national and regional conferences, interactive workshops, and customized consulting engagements with leading advisory teams. We maintain a strong industry presence through in-person, virtual, and digital experiences that extend Capital Group's practice management expertise to advisors nationwide. Our consulting services are highly sought after for their ability to drive meaningful business growth, leadership, and team transformation.

The APMC role requires leadership, collaboration, adaptability, and creativity. Consultants integrate and customize practice management curriculum across a variety of engagements while partnering with internal stakeholders to develop learning experiences aligned with advisor needs. Credibility is critical, as APMCs advise and coach top financial professionals on topics including client acquisition, leadership, team effectiveness, goals-based investing, retirement planning, AI strategy, and practice growth. Success in this role requires exceptional public speaking, facilitation, consulting, and coaching skills. Approximately 75% of the role is dedicated to workshops and consulting engagements, with roughly one-third conducted in person.

APMCs operate within a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment, partnering closely with Strategic Relationship Managers and sales teams across distribution channels to design and deliver customized practice management programs that drive advisor success.

"I can succeed as an Advisor Practice Management Consultant at Capital Group."
- Deliver guided learning through coaching and consulting experiences that help financial advisors and teams adopt new behaviors, strengthen business practices, and grow and scale their businesses.
- Lead a variety of engagements, including keynote presentations, workshops, and consulting sessions for top financial advisors, advisor teams, centers of influence (COIs), and home office leadership teams.
- Partner closely with sales professionals across distribution, including Strategic Relationship Managers, Strategic Sales Managers, Wealth Management Consultants, and Retirement Plan Counselors.
- Represent Capital Group as a thought leader, moderator, and facilitator across a wide range of events, including broker-dealer national and regional conferences, Capital Group Advisor Forum programs, webinars, podcasts, and other advisor engagement initiatives.
- Contribute to national and regional sales meetings by delivering practice management insights and expertise.
- Develop and enhance practice management curriculum, consulting tools, learning resources, workshop content, and sales force insights.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for.”
- Undergraduate or master's degree required.
- Minimum of 15 years of experience in the financial services industry.
- Experience as a financial advisor, investment management sales professional (wholesaler, retirement plan consultant, national accounts leader), or equivalent role.
- Outstanding communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
- Demonstrated experience coaching and consulting on practice management topics.
- Collaborative team player who embraces diverse perspectives and is innovative, highly organized, energetic, and results-oriented.
- Strong curriculum design and content development capabilities within practice management disciplines.
- Ability to travel extensively (approximately 400 engagements annually, one-third in person, including roughly 150 overnight stays).
- FINRA Series 7 and 66 licenses, or equivalent, required.

At Capital Group, we believe in the power of insight to drive enterprise value. Our Strategic Analysis (SA) team is a high-impact capability center within Global Finance, designed to elevate decision-making, accelerate transformation, and enable scalable growth across the firm.

As the Global Finance Senior Manager – Strategic Analysis (London), you will play a critical role as a thought partner to senior leaders across Capital Group to drive clarify, influence our global strategic direction, and deliver insights that shape Capital Group’s long-term global trajectory.

To thrive in this role, you will collaborate closely with high performing teams and leverage your strategy and analytical skills to navigate through ambiguity, bring structure to complexity and solve global enterprise-level challenges.

Responsibilities:

- Partner with cross-functional leaders to help answer key strategic questions through thoughtful framing and rigorous analysis

- Translate complex data into insights and compelling narratives that inform strategy, investment prioritization, and resource allocation.

- Drive initiatives aligned with Capital Group’s Long-Term Strategic Plan (LTSP), including strategic evaluation of new business initiatives, product economics, cost optimization, compensation analytics, operating model evolution, and enterprise transformation.

- Add to our culture of curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

- Serve as a connector across the enterprise, helping to align business priorities with financial and operational insights.

- Be a role model for Capital Group’s core values.

- Coach and inspire associates across Global Finance and our partner teams, help develop future leaders, and operate with high quality and efficiency.

“I am the right person Capital Group is looking for.”

- You have 5+ years of experience in management consulting, or 10+ years in corporate strategy or relevant strategic finance roles preferably in asset management or financial services.

- You are a proven strategic leader with demonstrated success in driving change and delivering measurable impact through hypothesis-driven problem solving.

- You are well versed in navigating high degrees of complexity and ambiguity with stakeholders at all levels and can steer through the cross-functional organizational maze to get things done for Capital.

- You are energized by ambiguity and excel at bringing clarity and direction to complex challenges.

- You see the big picture, set objectives to align to broader organizational goals and breakdown objectives into appropriate initiatives and actions.

- You collaborate and develop/maintain working relationships to enable effective completion of business objectives and influence decision-making.

- You embody our core values and can motivate and develop a high performing team.

- Access on-demand professional development resources that allow you to hone existing skills and learn new ones

“I can succeed as a Quantitative Research Associate at Capital Group”
As a member of the Quantitative Research and Analytics group (QRA) at Capital Group (CG), you conduct rigorous peer-reviewed quantitative research and analysis.  You leverage your knowledge of portfolio optimization, trading strategies and portfolio analysis to develop effective systematic strategies for portfolio construction and replication.  You enjoy a balance of collaborative problem-solving, individual exploration, and continuous learning.

You effectively communicate concepts and conclusions from quantitative analysis to investors, partner groups, and internal governance bodies.  You identify and communicate the factors driving returns in systematic portfolios.

In this role you will:
- Deliver high-impact research on portfolio construction and optimization.
- Develop and maintain relevant quantitative models and frameworks.
- Partner with QRA leadership, Portfolio Strategy Management leadership, and Investment Group associates to understand and execute on quantitative research and analytical priorities.
- Work collaboratively with members of the QRA team in a rigorous peer-reviewed approach to quantitative research and support the team with portfolio optimization expertise.
- Respond to deadline-driven requests requiring quantitative analysis.
- Participate in the ongoing development of quantitative research processes at CG.
- Communicate results and recommendations in a form that meets the needs of the listener.
- Help develop computing environments to support research and research-driven processes in a collaborative research environment.

”I am the person Capital Group is looking for”
- You have advanced knowledge of optimization methods (including convex, non-linear, and integer programming) and systematic portfolio construction methods, with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.
- You have excellent systems and computer skills, including demonstrable expertise with quantitative programming languages (e.g., Python, Julia, or R) and with optimization software (e.g. Gurobi or Mosek)
- You have at a minimum a basic knowledge of fundamental research, econometrics and modern financial economic theory: e.g. asset pricing, portfolio theory, factor risk models, and machine learning.
- You have excellent quantitative research skills, as evidenced by an advanced degree (MFE, MSc, PhD) in a mathematically robust discipline (e.g., mathematics, economics, operations research) or equivalent experience.
- You exhibit advanced communication skills – the ability to synthesize issues into solutions, translate complex concepts into simple language, and engage across different audiences.

- You are self-motivated, take initiative, and demonstrate commitment to continuously improve skills and self.
- You are curious about financial markets, optimization and portfolio construction, and are always learning something new.
